parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the source instance.

parameters.name: LinkId
parameters.description: The ID of the custom synchronization link.

parameters.name: NamespaceName
parameters.description: The namespace name of the source instance.

parameters.name: NamespaceNameFilter
parameters.description:
The instance-level namespace regex filter.
> This parameter takes effect only when SyncScope is set to `INSTANCE`.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description:
The execution priority of the synchronization task. Synchronization tasks are executed in descending order of priority. Tasks with the same priority are executed in random order.

Valid values: 1 to 5.

Default value: 3.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description: The repository name of the source instance.

parameters.name: RepoNameFilter
parameters.description:
The repository filter rule.
> This parameter takes effect only when SyncScope is set to `INSTANCE` or `NAMESPACE`.

parameters.name: SyncRuleName
parameters.description: The name of the synchronization rule.

parameters.name: SyncScope
parameters.description:
The synchronization type. Valid values:

- `REPO`: Synchronizes by image repository.

- `NAMESPACE`: Synchronizes by namespace.

- `INSTANCE`: Synchronizes by namespace regex and repository regex.

parameters.name: SyncTrigger
parameters.description:
The trigger for the synchronization action. Valid values:

- `INITIATIVE`: Manual trigger.
 
- `PASSIVE`: Automatic trigger.

parameters.name: TargetInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetNamespaceName
parameters.description: The namespace name of the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetRepoName
parameters.description: The image repository name of the target instance.

parameters.name: TargetUserId
parameters.description:
The UID of the account to which the target instance belongs.

> This parameter is required for cross-account image synchronization.
